verdict.rationale: cubic ships its own analytics dashboard. It has an AI review tab showing what reviews find and what the team fixes, plus delivery-speed views, and an Analytics API exposes flagged and fixed issue counts per PR. This covers findings and a fix-based proxy for acceptance. Review coverage across the org is never explicitly documented as a metric. Missing for 10: explicit review-coverage metric, explicit acceptance-rate metric (only flagged-vs-fixed counts), org-wide rollup detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I see dashboards of findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage across my org

citations.quote: The analytics page shows what cubic's reviews find and what your team fixes, how fast your PRs merge, and how much of your code AI writes.
The AI review tab shows whether cubic reviews are helping your team ship better code faster.
The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed
The analytics dashboard shows how your team ships code across three lenses: AI coding usage, AI review impact, and delivery speed.
